newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Arco to build new plant in Rotterdam.
newsitem.headline: Arco to build new plant in Rotterdam.

text.p: Arco Chemical Company said on Friday it had started engineering a butanediol plant in the Rotterdam Maasvlakte industrial area, adjacent to its propylene oxide/styrene plant currently under construction.
The new plant for butanediol, a relatively new derivative of propylene oxyde, will have capacity of 115,000 tonnes and is anticipated to start in 2001.
Arco also said it will raise capacity at its butanediol plant in Channelview, Texas, to 55,000 tonnes per year, due to come on stream in late 1997.
Arco Chemicals said it was currently the leading producer of butanediol and its derivatives, while it planned to become the largest merchant supplier in the world.
"This new European plant is the next step towards that goal," it said in a statement.
No one at Arco was immediately available to comment.
Arco will use the propylene oxyde from its new Rotterdam plant as a feedstock for the adjacent butanediol site.
It said it also planned to build capacity for a range of butanediol derivative products in Rotterdam.
In April Arco announced a grassroots plant for propylene oxyde and styrene in Rotterdam. Completion is expected in 1999.
